title: Visual Check and Periodic Inspection
overview: Inspect the CAPS 1200 EL for signs of wear, corrosion, leaks, cracks, misalignment, or damage.

steps.title: Step 1: Inspect the valve seat and stem for scoring, corrosion, or uneven wear.
steps.description: Check the valve seat and stem for signs of scoring, corrosion, or uneven wear. The valve should be clean and free from debris.

steps.title: Step 2: Inspect the pump stage for accumulation of contaminants or corrosive substances.
steps.description: Check the pump stage for accumulation of reddish-orange substance, which could indicate corrosion or buildup of contaminants. The surface should be clean and free from debris.

steps.title: Step 3: Inspect the engine for signs of wear, corrosion, or leaks.
steps.description: Check the engine for signs of rust formation, oil leaks, or excessive wear. The surface should be clean and free from debris.

steps.title: Step 4: Inspect the hydraulic filters for proper installation and condition.
steps.description: Check the hydraulic filters for proper installation, cleanliness, and condition. The filters should be free from debris and damage.

steps.title: Step 5: Inspect the valve for proper operation and gauge readings.
steps.description: Check the valve gauges for proper operation, cleanliness, and condition. The gauges should be accurate and free from debris.

steps.title: Step 6: Check the hydraulic fluid level indicator for proper installation and condition.
steps.description: Check the hydraulic fluid level indicator for proper installation, cleanliness, and condition. The indicator should be accurate and free from debris.

steps.title: Step 7: Inspect the machine components for signs of wear, corrosion, or damage.
steps.description: Check the machine components for signs of rust formation, oxidation, or excessive wear. The surface should be clean and free from debris.
